notes: Your desktop pet always wears your saved look (animal, outfit, hats, colours, skill), and Customize shows whether it does
No more My pets tab: name your pet in Customize; extra pets on this PC are in Settings
The menu can be collapsed to icons, scrolls on its own, and the Hub adapts when you resize the window
Music: no more sudden Nibble Beats, smoother YouTube playback, Pause really pauses (also from your keyboard's media keys), old rooms don't start playing again by themselves
